data.content: APPROVED. The plan covers all five acceptance criteria, uses a disposable policy boundary before production refs, keeps untrusted inbox objects out of the workflow checkout/execution path, and makes no destructive cleanup. The noted GitHub wildcard/PAT limitation is handled by semantic writer registration in the trusted integrator; the provider capability must remain fail-closed until the live semantic check and append-only rules are both verified. Tests include forbidden role bypasses, exact ref patterns, trust-boundary inspection, and live ordinary-vs-Actions canaries.
